items.criterion: Open the correct Hugging Face repository page
items.description: Navigate to the Hugging Face repo page for exactly `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` and base answers on visible on-page metadata from that repo. Full credit if the agent clearly indicates it is on the correct repo page (e.g., matching org/model slug shown in the UI). Partial credit if the agent appears to reference the correct repo but the evidence is weak/indirect. If Hugging Face is inaccessible (down, blocked, persistent error), full credit if the agent reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt and does not substitute guesses from the model name.

items.criterion: Report license name from visible metadata
items.description: Record the license name exactly as shown in the repo’s visible metadata (license field/badge). Full credit if the license is correctly transcribed from the page or if the agent explicitly states that the license field is not visible due to gating, page rendering issues, or site access restrictions encountered (and does not guess). Partial credit if a license is provided but evidence is unclear or the transcription is slightly mismatched. No credit if the agent guesses the license without visible support when the field is not accessible/visible.

items.criterion: Report current likes count from visible metadata
items.description: Record the likes count as displayed on the repository page at the time of viewing. Full credit if the exact number shown in the UI is reported, or if the agent explicitly states the likes count is not visible (e.g., blocked by gating, requires sign-in/JS that failed, or page not loading) after attempting to view the page, and does not fabricate a number. Partial credit if an approximate/uncertain count is given with a clear explanation of why it could not be precisely read. No credit if the likes count is omitted without explanation or is invented.

items.criterion: Determine and report whether the repository is gated (from visible cues)
items.description: State whether the repository is gated based on visible Hugging Face UI cues (e.g., 'You need to agree/request access' notice, gated banner, restricted files). Full credit if gated status is correctly determined from visible cues; if the page cannot be accessed or gating cues are not visible due to site errors, full credit if the agent reports that it cannot determine gated status from the visible page without signing in (and does not guess). Partial credit if the agent infers gating but the cited evidence is ambiguous.

Do not sign in, do not request access, do not download model files, and stop once license, likes, and gated-status (or inability-to-observe due to external limitations) have been recorded. Full credit if all constraints are respected and the agent does not continue beyond the requested scope. Partial credit if minor extra navigation/details are included but no constraint is violated.
